title: 美股盘前：期指近乎平盘、AI信用压力延续，TSLA与VRNS逆势；AA获盈利正反馈
summary: Reuters 07:51 ET显示道指期货-0.04%、标普500期货+0.04%、纳指100期货-0.28%。CoreWeave再跌5.2%，MU与INTC继续承压；TSLA因新Roadster涨约3%至5%，VRNS因63亿美元现金并购涨2.6%，AA盈利超预期后涨逾2%。

重大新闻汇总
国际市场
美股小幅收高，资金转向医疗和材料
10月15日标普500涨0.33%、纳指涨0.08%、道指涨1.08%；医疗和材料分别涨1.84%和1.71%，但费城半导体指数跌0.9%并连续第七日下跌，防御轮动没有消除AI硬件压力。 source
隔夜科技
服务器硬件继续承受资本开支疑虑
Dell跌6.9%、HPE跌7.1%、Nvidia跌1.8%；A/H光模块、PCB和服务器链即使有盈利预喜，也必须等待本地价格确认，不能把美股概念上涨直接包装成多头信号。 source
国内政策
国内成品油价格本轮暂不调整
国家发展改革委10月15日宣布本轮汽柴油价格不作调整，并要求企业组织好供应、严格执行价格政策；炼化与运输链条短线以保供稳价为主。 source
国内政策
七部门发布安全应急装备典型应用案例
工信部10月15日公布2026年安全应急装备应用推广典型案例名单，为监测预警、应急通信和特种装备提供政策线索；名单入选不等于订单或利润兑现。 source
A股科技
光迅科技前三季度盈利预增65%至82%
公司预计归母净利润11.89亿至13.10亿元，AI资本开支和云数据中心需求带动产品放量；09:41 CST股价137.36元、上涨3.31%，量比5.44，量价反馈确认催化，但冲高回落不宜追涨。 source
A股科技
深南电路前三季度盈利预增74%至78%
公司预计归母净利润40.5亿至41.5亿元，AI服务器、高速交换机、光模块与封装载板需求构成支撑；09:41 CST股价316.94元、下跌0.58%，高开后走弱，故仍仅列条件关注。 source
A股算力
海光信息与中科曙光披露增长线索
公告摘要显示海光信息前三季度盈利预增，中科曙光收入与利润增长；因未完成同步报价核验，本次只作为算力链佐证，不单独生成个股卡。 source
港股业绩
招金矿业收入增长但利润与现金流下降
截至9月底收入同比增约8.7%，归母净利润同比降约7.0%，经营现金流同比降约12.8%；贵金属板块强势不能掩盖公司盈利质量反证。 source
港股公告
J&T Express与圣贝拉披露股份回购
HKEX晚间披露显示两家公司发布翌日披露报表确认回购；本轮未提取足够规模与价格细节，因此仅记为治理/资本动作，不直接形成推荐。 source
美股映射
加密概念强势，但A/H直接可交易映射有限
概念榜前五中四项与加密储备相关；由于A/H上市公司多数仅具间接敞口且监管与资产属性不同，本次不据此生成多头卡片。 source
A/H开盘
A/H指数同步反弹，科技修复强于大盘
截至09:41，上证涨0.57%、创业板涨0.88%、恒指涨1.27%、恒生科技涨2.16%；这改变了首轮“风险偏好仍弱”的判断，但单一开盘时点尚不足以确认趋势反转。 source

隔夜美股与当前期指

期指
运行时美股期指轻微转弱
约08:00 CST可得报价显示标普500期指约跌0.17%、道指期货约跌0.08%、纳指100期货约跌0.47%；这是运行时快照，不是A/H开盘结果。
代表股
榜单代表股未取得同一时点批量报价
VEEE、MF、BETR、REAL、HSLV、BTCT、WWW、CYPH、DFDV未能取得同一时点完整盘后报价，无法确认行业/概念强势是否延续，结论保持待确认。
跨资产
长债收益率回落，但油价仍在高位
10年期美债收益率降至约5.064%，美元指数约101.99；布油结算105.92美元、微跌0.13%，现货黄金涨约1.57%，反映增长与通胀担忧并存。

盘中结论

隔夜半导体弱势并未阻止A/H开盘修复：09:41上证涨0.57%、创业板涨0.88%、恒指涨1.27%、恒生科技涨2.16%。光迅科技涨3.31%，盈利预喜获得本地价格确认并升级为确认关注；深南电路跌0.58%，暂未跟随大盘修复，维持条件关注；招金矿业跌3.50%，利润和现金流反证得到价格确认，继续回避。

重点个股推荐

光迅科技
002281.SZ
确认关注
前三季度归母净利润预计同比增长65.37%至82.26%，AI资本开支和云数据中心需求构成公司级催化。
截至09:41，报137.36元、涨3.31%，量比5.44；昨日负反馈后出现高开承接，盈利预喜获得价格确认。
确认条件：继续强于光模块板块，且业绩预告细项无重大不利修正。
失效条件：继续放量弱于板块、AI资本开支预期下修或公司公告出现重大负面。
深南电路
002916.SZ
条件关注
前三季度归母净利润预计同比增长74.13%至78.43%，AI服务器、高速交换机、光模块与封装载板需求形成业务支撑。
截至09:41，报316.94元、跌0.58%；在主要指数反弹时仍偏弱，盈利预喜尚未获得同步价格确认。
确认条件：止跌并不弱于PCB/算力硬件板块，量价承接与盈利预告方向一致。
失效条件：板块继续受美股服务器硬件抛售拖累，或公司后续指引低于预期。
招金矿业
01818.HK
回避
前三季度收入约135.10亿元、同比增长约8.7%，但归母净利润约19.70亿元、同比下降约7.0%，经营现金流约33.12亿元、同比下降约12.8%。
截至09:41，报16.80港元、跌3.50%；价格反馈与利润、经营现金流下降的反证一致，继续回避。
重新评估条件：利润率和经营现金流明确改善，且价格重新获得贵金属板块相对强度。
风险：金价波动、成本上升与现金流弱化可能继续压制估值。

板块轮动看板

光模块与PCB港股光通信概念与恒生科技反弹，光迅涨3.31%确认业绩催化；深南跌0.58%，板块内部仍分化。
医疗与材料隔夜美股防御板块领涨，但A/H没有完成公司级催化与同步报价核验的标的，不机械追随。
贵金属白银行业榜强势、黄金上涨，但招金利润与经营现金流下降，主题与公司基本面背离。
安全应急装备七部门典型案例提供政策方向，后续需以订单、收入和公告确认。

逻辑链

美股指数温和上涨 + 半导体连续第七日下跌 → 风格转向防御 → A/H算力链只看业绩兑现与价格承接。
光迅、深南盈利预喜 → 光迅涨3.31%、深南跌0.58% → 同类催化出现价格分化，只升级已获确认者。
白银、加密概念领涨 → A/H直接映射不足 → 不以题材替代公司催化；招金因利润与现金流反证列为回避。
上证、创业板、恒指与恒生科技同步反弹 → 风险偏好边际修复 → 仍需午前宽度与成交延续确认。

风险雷达

科技估值与资本开支服务器硬件和半导体延续下跌，盈利预喜也可能被估值收缩抵消。
市场宽度滞后AKShare仅有10月15日12:41盘中快照，不是今日开盘前实时数据。
开盘时点09:41行情覆盖主要指数与三张个股卡，但仍是单一时点；反弹持续性和市场宽度尚待确认。
主题映射加密、体育、广告和抵押贷款主题对A/H公司的直接盈利映射有限。
数据与来源：隔夜美股与跨资产来自Reuters及公开市场报价（10月15日收盘）；美股行业/概念榜来自GitHub Actions快照，抓取于2026-10-16 07:42 CST并覆盖10月15日完整美股交易时段，行业仅取得Top5，最后页Bottom5请求超时；概念取得Top5。AKShare为2026-10-15 12:41 CST盘中快照，非今日实时。政策与公司证据来自国家发展改革委、工信部、深交所披露、上交所公告入口及HKEX。09:41 CST云端行情回读覆盖上证、创业板、恒指、恒生科技及三张个股卡；单一时点仅用于增量确认。增量复核于2026-10-16 09:43 CST。

Major News
Global
US stocks edge higher as money rotates to healthcare and materials
On Oct. 15 the S&P 500 rose 0.33%, Nasdaq 0.08% and Dow 1.08%; healthcare and materials gained 1.84% and 1.71%, but the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 0.9% for a seventh straight decline. source
US tech
Server hardware remains under capex pressure
Dell fell 6.9%, HPE 7.1% and Nvidia 1.8%. A/H optical, PCB and server names still need local price confirmation even when earnings improve. source
China policy

China policy
Seven agencies publish emergency-equipment use cases
MIIT published a 2026 list covering monitoring, emergency communications and specialized equipment. Inclusion is a policy signal, not proof of orders or profit. source
A-share tech
Accelink forecasts 65%-82% nine-month profit growth
AI capex and cloud data-center demand supported growth. At 09:41 CST the stock was CNY 137.36, up 3.31% with a 5.44 volume ratio; the price-volume response confirms the catalyst, while the pullback from the high argues against chasing. source
A-share tech
SCC forecasts 74%-78% nine-month profit growth
AI servers, high-speed switches, optical modules and substrates supported the outlook. At 09:41 CST the stock was CNY 316.94, down 0.58% after opening higher, so it remains a conditional watch. source
A-share compute
Hygon and Sugon add growth evidence
Announcement summaries point to profit and revenue growth, but without synchronized quote checks they remain sector evidence and do not get stock cards. source
HK earnings
Zhaojin revenue rises while profit and cash flow decline
Nine-month revenue rose about 8.7%, but attributable profit fell about 7.0% and operating cash flow about 12.8%. Strong precious-metals themes do not erase this company-level contradiction. source
HK filings
J&T Express and Saint Bella disclose buybacks
HKEX next-day disclosures confirmed repurchases, but this run did not extract enough size and price detail to turn them into stock calls. source
US-to-A/H map
Crypto concepts rally, but direct A/H mappings are limited
Four of the top five concept rows were crypto-treasury related. Most A/H exposures are indirect and subject to different regulation and asset economics, so no bullish card is created. source
A/H
A/H indices rebound together, with the tech repair outpacing the broad market
At 09:41 CST, Shanghai rose 0.57%, ChiNext 0.88%, Hang Seng 1.27% and Hang Seng Tech 2.16%. The synchronized rebound materially changes the prior-session weak-breadth read, while the larger tech gain still looks like an oversold repair rather than proof that the semiconductor downtrend has ended. source

Overnight US and Current Futures

Futures
US index futures soften during this run
Around 08:00 CST, available quotes showed S&P 500 futures near -0.17%, Dow futures -0.08% and Nasdaq 100 futures -0.47%. This is a runtime snapshot, not an A/H open outcome.
Leaders
No same-time batch quote for ranking representatives
A synchronized after-hours batch for VEEE, MF, BETR, REAL, HSLV, BTCT, WWW, CYPH and DFDV was unavailable, so persistence of the ranking moves remains unconfirmed.
Cross-assets
Long yields ease while oil stays elevated
The US 10-year yield fell to about 5.064% and the dollar index to about 101.99. Brent settled at $105.92, down 0.13%, while spot gold rose about 1.57%.

Intraday Takeaway

By 09:41 CST, A/H benchmarks had rebounded together and Hong Kong tech led the repair, reversing the prior-session breadth signal. Price action still separates the earnings candidates: Accelink gained 3.31% on elevated volume and is upgraded to a confirmed watch, while Shennan Circuits slipped 0.58% and remains conditional. Zhaojin fell 3.50%, reinforcing the avoid stance. The rebound improves tactical risk appetite but does not erase the seventh straight decline in US semiconductors.

Key Stock Calls

Accelink Technologies
002281.SZ
Confirmed Watch
Nine-month attributable profit is forecast to rise 65.37%-82.26%, with AI capex and cloud data centers providing a company-level catalyst.
At 09:41 CST the stock was CNY 137.36, up 3.31%, with a 5.44 volume ratio after reaching CNY 141.00. The positive price-volume response confirms the catalyst while the intraday pullback argues against chasing.
Confirmation: price action stabilizes with relative strength versus optical peers, with no adverse forecast revision.
Invalidation: continued high-volume underperformance, lower AI capex expectations or a material negative filing.
Shennan Circuits
002916.SZ
Conditional Watch
Nine-month attributable profit is forecast to rise 74.13%-78.43%, supported by AI servers, high-speed switches, optical modules and substrates.
At 09:41 CST the stock was CNY 316.94, down 0.58% after opening higher at CNY 322.32. The earnings catalyst is verified, but lagging price feedback keeps the call conditional.
Confirmation: opens no weaker than PCB/compute hardware peers and shows price-volume support consistent with the forecast.
Invalidation: overseas hardware weakness spills over or later company guidance disappoints.
Zhaojin Mining
01818.HK
Avoid
Nine-month revenue was about RMB13.51bn, up roughly 8.7%, but attributable profit fell about 7.0% to RMB1.97bn and operating cash flow fell about 12.8% to RMB3.31bn.
At 09:41 CST the stock was HK$16.80, down 3.50% after opening at HK$17.50. The fresh negative feedback confirms that the silver theme should not be packaged as bullish.
Revisit only if: margins and operating cash flow clearly improve and price regains relative strength versus precious-metal peers.
Risk: gold-price volatility, higher costs and weaker cash conversion can keep pressure on valuation.

Sector Rotation Board

Optical and PCBAccelink confirms the earnings catalyst with a 3.31% gain and high volume; SCC remains conditional after slipping 0.58%.
Broad-market reboundA/H benchmarks rebound together, but the move is still an oversold repair rather than proof of a durable trend reversal.
Precious MetalsSilver and gold were strong, but Zhaojin's profit and operating cash flow declined.
Safety EquipmentThe policy list offers direction; orders, revenue and company filings must confirm the thesis.

Logic Chain

Modest US gains + seventh straight semiconductor decline → defensive rotation → A/H compute names need both earnings delivery and local price support.
Accelink and SCC profit forecasts → company-level AI hardware delivery → Accelink gains 3.31% on strong volume while SCC slips 0.58% → confirmed watch versus conditional watch.
Silver and crypto concepts lead → direct A/H mapping remains weak → do not substitute themes for company evidence; Zhaojin stays an avoid.
Shanghai, ChiNext, Hang Seng and Hang Seng Tech rebound together → tactical risk appetite repairs → keep exposure controlled because US semiconductors remain weak and the move is still an oversold rebound.

Risk Radar

Tech valuation and capexServer hardware and semis remain weak; valuation compression can offset earnings beats.
Rebound durabilityThe 09:41 index rebound repairs the prior-session breadth signal but does not prove a durable trend reversal.
Price divergenceAccelink confirms its catalyst, but SCC still lags and Zhaojin weakens; watch cards are not immediate buy instructions.
Theme mappingCrypto, sports, advertising and mortgage themes have limited direct A/H earnings links.

Live 09:41 CST cloud quotes were checked for Shanghai, ChiNext, Hang Seng, Hang Seng Tech, Accelink, SCC and Zhaojin; these intraday readings supersede the prior-session breadth snapshot only where explicitly stated.
